open_points.subject: A17 startup checks and serving barrier
open_points.question: Which module owns and coordinates A17's ordered startup checks, rollback, and rule that nothing is served until all checks and listener bindings succeed, given that `configuration` is the primary owner but may not know the later `store`, `backups`, `service_access`, `owner_sessions`, or `instance_lifecycle` modules?
options: `instance_lifecycle` owns the orchestration and delegates individual checks to the listed consumers
`configuration` owns the orchestration despite the stated dependency order
The responsibility is split, with an explicitly named coordinator and an exact allocation of checks and rollback duties
open_points.default_guess: Make `instance_lifecycle` the coordinator; let `configuration` validate loaded settings and delegate resource checks to their owning modules.

open_points.subject: A17 listener creation and exclusive binding
open_points.text: Registry serves each surface it opens — the service API not at all in an owner-only start (A17 rule 1) — on a listener of its own, at its configured address
open_points.question: Which module creates and exclusively binds each listener, retains it until all startup checks pass, closes it on a later binding failure, and hands it to the corresponding surface?
options: `instance_lifecycle` binds both listeners and injects them into `service_api` and `owner_interface`
`service_api` and `owner_interface` each bind their own listener under lifecycle coordination
`configuration` binds the listeners as part of checking the configuration
open_points.default_guess: Have `instance_lifecycle` bind and retain both listeners, close them on any startup failure, and pass the successful listeners to the two surface modules.
